baseline_models.focus_anchor: The temporal يوم, passive يكشف, indefinite ساق, passive يدعون, and final فلا يستطيعون form one pressure-to-response sequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: A severe event arrives, a cover is removed and a fault-bearing condition emerges, the idiom of the uncovered shank intensifies the crisis, and a summons toward low submission meets absent practical capacity.

activation_trace.role: The severe event-day supplies the temporal pressure that frames disclosure and failed response.
Emergence after concealment, including exposure of a fault, makes the passive unveiling diagnostic rather than merely visual.
Uncovering the shank as severity and readiness turns the disclosed object into the crisis itself.
A voiced call that draws its addressee supplies the directed movement toward the demanded act.
Humble lowering supplies the social and bodily endpoint of the summons.
Practical capacity supplies the blocked enabling condition named by the final negation.

changed_reading.before: A future day contains an uncovering, a call to prostrate, and an inability.
changed_reading.after: A severe disclosure-event exposes a condition and demands humble response precisely where practical capacity fails.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence كشف عن ساق ثم السجود ثم نفي الاستطاعة joins exposure, a load-bearing limb or stem, postural lowering, and capacity.
baseline_models.mechanism: The uncovered ساق can coexist with the severity idiom as an exposed support: what ordinarily bears and holds upright is made visible, then tested by a demand to bend, and the body-person system cannot execute the transition.

activation_trace.role: Removing a cover supplies literal exposure of what had borne weight unseen.
The leg, shank, or supporting stem supplies the load-bearing element placed under inspection.
Bowing and lowering the head supply the required reversal from upright support to bent posture.
Practical ability supplies the failed coordination between support and lowering.

changed_reading.before: Saq is either a literal shin or a conventional token of severity.
changed_reading.after: Without canceling the idiom, the verse can expose the very support that keeps a person upright and then reveal its inability to convert into prostration.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root ط و ع inside يستطيعون follows a call to سجود, allowing capacity and willing pliancy to resonate without being equated.
baseline_models.mechanism: The final inability is not exhausted by muscular incapacity: the same root inventory carries willing yielding, practical ability, and the self making an act easy. The called subjects cannot make themselves pliant to the low posture requested of them.

activation_trace.role: The call draws the addressees toward a response and therefore tests more than static bodily power.
Humble submission supplies the volitional quality of the demanded movement.
Pliant obedience supplies the willingness latent inside the capacity root.
Practical capacity preserves the ordinary force of يستطيعون while allowing the volitional resonance to coexist.
The self making an act easy supplies an inner enabling process whose failure can appear as inability.

changed_reading.before: They lack the power to perform a physical act.
changed_reading.after: Their incapacity also exposes a failure of inner pliancy: they cannot become willing and workable toward submission.

context_deltas.mechanism: Writing and aligned inscription at the opening, followed by an uncitable marking construction on the nose, activate the focus body as a record: the shin is uncovered and prostration's limbs or mark make inward allegiance externally legible.

activation_trace.role: The trimmed writing reed supplies inscription as a way hidden content becomes a durable visible record.
The ordered written line supplies the record-like arrangement later transferred abductively to bodily signs.
The nose or snout supplies the first explicit body location in the marking construction.
Exposure of a hidden condition makes the focus body readable rather than merely displayed.
Prostration limbs and their mark supply the body's own evidentiary inscription.

structural_cues: 68:1 opens with writing, 68:16 places the branchless و س م action at word 1 upon a named body part, and 68:42 exposes another body part; the missing و س م inventory is used only as sequence and grammar.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies writing, an uncitable body-marking construction, body locations, exposure, and prostration marks; I infer that the body functions as a readable record. A live alternative is that 68:16 and 68:42 are separate punishments with no inscription mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus reports an event enacted upon bodies.
changed_reading.after: The focus can make bodies disclose the record they had carried invisibly: exposed support and prostration marks become evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context repeatedly supplies coverings of mind and truth, hiddenness from sight, and exposure in an unsheltered open space. The focus passive uncovering becomes the hinge where cover is stripped from the load-bearing condition itself.

activation_trace.role: Covering the intellect supplies a cognitive form of concealment surrounding the opening accusation.
Removing a cover supplies the central reversal of the surrounding concealment field.
The shank as supporting stem locates disclosure at what bears the visible person.
What is screened from eyes extends concealment into the claimed possession of unseen knowledge.
An open space without cover supplies the contextual opposite of shelter and concealment.
Covering the truth supplies the deliberate concealment that the focus disclosure can undo.

structural_cues: Concealment images occur before and after 68:42, while its passive disclosure occupies the hinge between accusation, claimed hidden knowledge, exposure, and renewed covering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies several distinct covers and an uncovered open space; I infer a shared concealment-to-exposure mechanism centered on the focus support. A live alternative is that only the local severity idiom governs ساق and the wider cover field is thematic rather than causal.

changed_reading.before: A severe situation is announced by uncovering a shin.
changed_reading.after: The severe situation strips cognitive, epistemic, and moral cover until the support beneath the public person is exposed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence prohibits obedience to deniers, depicts their wish for reciprocal soft accommodation, and again prohibits obedience. Against that selective flexibility, the focus inability reads as a trained rigidity: pliant toward compromise, unworkable toward humble submission.

activation_trace.role: Pliant obedience supplies the first explicit allegiance choice that the context rejects.
Mutual soft accommodation supplies a counterfeit flexibility offered in place of principled yielding.
The repeated obedience root confirms that pliancy is being allocated to an object, not treated as neutral capacity.
Humble lowering supplies the form of pliancy that is finally unavailable.
Practical capacity turns the prior allegiance pattern into a terminal inability to perform.

structural_cues: 68:8-10 alternates prohibited obedience, desired reciprocal accommodation, and prohibited obedience; 68:42 ends with the same root inside a negated ability form.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies selective obedience, accommodating softness, and later inability; I infer that repeated pliancy in the wrong direction hardens into incapacity in the demanded direction. A live alternative is a purely imposed bodily incapacity with no habituation arrow.

changed_reading.before: The final inability is an isolated loss of power.
changed_reading.after: The final inability exposes misdirected pliancy: flexible for reciprocal compromise, rigid when called to humble submission.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context characterizes a social agent through prodding movement, violent dragging, and refusal to yield. Those motion images activate the split دعو inventory and سوق in the focus, so a neutral summons acquires the edge of forceful driving while the former driver becomes the unresponsive recipient.

activation_trace.role: A prod that pushes something into motion supplies the earlier agentive pattern of moving others.
Violent dragging and driving intensify the contextual pattern of coercive motion.
Refusal to yield supplies the rigid disposition that survives when the agent becomes an addressee.
The non-dominant split image of rough thrusting gives the passive summons a contained coercive undertone.
Driving and impelling forward connects the revealed ساق sound-field to the reversal of mover and moved.
Low submission supplies the posture the formerly forceful subject cannot now enter.

structural_cues: The earlier portrait is active and transitive toward others; the focus uses passive verbs for the same group's exposure and summons.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prodding, violent dragging, non-yielding, and focus branches of thrusting and driving; I infer an agent-to-patient reversal. A live alternative is that the split دعو and سوق sound-field is only lexical resonance and the summons remains non-coercive.

changed_reading.before: They receive a neutral call and fail to comply.
changed_reading.after: Those marked by pushing others are themselves placed under a driving summons, yet their cultivated non-yielding leaves them unable to enter submission.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden sequence tests and exposes a hidden condition: resolved cutters go out describing themselves as capable, but the intended harvest becomes deprivation. The focus repeats that agency reversal at greater intensity, distinguishing capacity to exclude from capacity to submit.

activation_trace.role: A test that makes the underlying condition appear supplies the garden episode's disclosure mechanism.
Cutting the date harvest supplies the concrete action the owners confidently plan.
Capacity that enables possession and action supplies the owners' self-assessed readiness.
Deprivation and failure to obtain the goal supply the reversal of their asserted capacity.
Exposure of a condition scales the garden's revealed failure into the focus event.
Negated practical capacity completes the second and more severe agency reversal.

structural_cues: 68:17-27 moves from oath and resolved harvest, through a morning journey made as capable actors, to recognition of deprivation; 68:42 compresses event, disclosure, demand, and incapacity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two exposure-and-capacity sequences; I infer that the garden is a material rehearsal for the focus and that their capacities are morally asymmetric. A live alternative is simple narrative analogy without a causal relation between exclusion and later incapacity.

changed_reading.before: They simply lose the capacity to prostrate at the final event.
changed_reading.after: Their inability is the terminal form of a prior reversal: capable when moving to exclude, exposed as powerless when called to submit.

context_deltas.mechanism: A sustained forensic sequence asks for judgment, book, binding oaths, a guarantor, and partners who can be produced. It activates دعو as claim or affiliation and prostration limbs as evidence: the focus summons claimants to enact the allegiance their claims require, and inability is failure of proof.

activation_trace.role: Judgment between parties supplies the forensic frame for the questions preceding the focus.
A writing that establishes an obligation or decree supplies documentary authority the claimants are asked to produce.
The binding oath supplies another asserted warrant extending to the event-day.
Resurrection and the rising of the Hour identify the legal claims' endpoint with the focus day.
Assuming a guarantee supplies the demanded representative who would answer for the claim.
Participation or partnership supplies the affiliations that must be produced and tested.
Claiming a right or affiliation lets the passive call function as a summons to substantiate claimed belonging.
The limbs and mark of prostration supply embodied evidence where books, oaths, guarantors, and partners fail.

structural_cues: 68:35-41 forms an escalating interrogation about classification and warrants; 68:42 answers with an enacted bodily demand rather than another verbal claim.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a legal interrogation, claim and affiliation imagery, and prostration's bodily evidence; I infer that the commanded act is probative enactment. A live alternative is that the questions merely precede a ritual scene without turning the ritual into proof.

changed_reading.before: The call to prostration is a ritual command after rhetorical questions.
changed_reading.after: The call is also an evidentiary summons: claimed judgment, warrants, guarantors, and affiliations must become embodied allegiance, but cannot.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately following ayah supplies a retrospective control: the same call to prostration had reached them while they were sound or intact. Present inability is therefore temporally charged by an earlier interval of capacity, while lowered eyes, engulfing abasement, and coercive humiliation distinguish forced lowness from chosen prostration.

activation_trace.role: Lowering in submission supplies a visible posture that resembles prostration while occurring under exposure.
Eyesight locates the forced lowering in their gaze and makes humiliation perceptible.
An engulfing force supplies the pressure under which abasement covers them.
Brokenness under compulsion differentiates imposed humiliation from willing humble lowering.
The repeated call identifies the earlier opportunity as the same directed summons found in the focus.
Repeated humble submission fixes the act across the earlier and present moments.
Soundness and freedom from impairment supply the earlier state against which current incapacity is measured.
Negated practical capacity marks the now-closed state that the retrospective cue changes.

structural_cues: 68:43 is adjacent, repeats the passive call and prostration, and contrasts a prior سالمون state with the focus's present negated ability.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prior soundness, repeated summons, present inability, and forced humiliation; I infer an expired or forfeited opportunity to convert capacity into willing submission. A live alternative is that سالمون means merely safe or physically intact, leaving the cause of later inability unspecified.

changed_reading.before: The subjects happen to be unable when the final call arrives.
changed_reading.after: The inability is a changed state measured against an earlier intact opportunity: they can be forced low in shame after losing the capacity for chosen prostration.

context_deltas.mechanism: Stepwise taking, extended respite, strategic treatment, and apparent firmness make the focus moment an engineered endpoint rather than a sudden arbitrary collapse. Time lets the subjects remain apparently supported until the event exposes that firmness as unable to lower itself.

activation_trace.role: Taking by degrees supplies the staged progression toward a concealed endpoint.
Granting an extended interval supplies the delay during which apparent capacity persists.
Strategic contrivance supplies hidden direction beneath the granted respite.
Extended hardness supplies the apparent firmness of the process and its subjects.
The event-day supplies the delayed process's moment of arrival.
Removing the cover discloses what the gradual process had kept from view.
The supporting stem supplies the apparently firm vertical structure tested at the endpoint.

structural_cues: 68:44-45 names gradual movement and respite immediately after the focus pair, reconstructing the temporal path by which the disclosed state was reached.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies graded movement, time extension, hidden strategy, and firmness; I infer that the focus disclosure is their designed endpoint and that apparent hardness prevents flexible lowering. A live alternative is that these verses describe only what follows rejection and do not explain the mechanics of 68:42.

changed_reading.before: The inability appears abruptly on the severe day.
changed_reading.after: The severe day is the delayed endpoint of a stepwise extension in which apparent firmness is preserved until its incapacity is exposed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant س ط ع mapping carried under focus ط و ع, not the ordinary استطاعة sense. It remains anchored in the focus through the explicit supporting ساق and bending سجود sequence, with 68:39 adding standing imagery. Downstream prose should present it only as a form-distant vertical latent image, never as a lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places a supporting shank, a command to bend, and ط و ع with a non-dominant upright-post branch in one short sequence.

activation_trace.role: Bodily standing supplies the vertical state named by the Day of Standing before the focus.
The leg or supporting stem supplies the lower post that maintains uprightness.
Bowing and lowering the head supply the required conversion out of upright posture.
The non-dominant upright-post image supplies a rigid verticality that cannot convert itself into bending.

changed_reading.after: Their uprightness has become post-like rigidity: the very structure that holds them up cannot transform into chosen lowering.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The kinetic link from hostile sight to failed footing is cross-domain and therefore surprising. It remains valid as an activation because the focus explicitly joins exposure, a supporting shank, and a prostration branch of lowered gaze, while 68:51 joins eyes to dislodgement. Downstream prose should qualify it as a visual-postural reversal, not claim that looking literally causes their incapacity.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins exposure, the supporting ساق, and سجود whose inventory includes a lowered steady gaze.

activation_trace.role: Reciprocal bodily seeing opens the visual contest whose direction later reverses.
Exposure makes the formerly judging observers themselves visible and inspectable.
The shank as bodily support supplies the footing vulnerable to dislocation.
A sustained lowered gaze supplies a visual rendering of the prostration demand.
Their humbled eyes supply the reversal from active looking to visibly lowered sight.
Slipping from one's station on a surface where feet cannot hold supplies the kinetic consequence attached to hostile sight.
The eyes explicitly serve as the contextual vehicle for attempted dislodgement.

changed_reading.before: The scene concerns inability to prostrate, while hostile looking elsewhere is separate.
changed_reading.after: The visual aggressors undergo a reversal: exposure lowers their gaze and reveals that their own support cannot secure the demanded posture.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the دعو branch of successive falling rather than the ordinary branch of vocal calling. It stays anchored through the passive summons immediately followed by low prostration and negated capacity, with the later stepwise cue preserving a sequence mechanism. Downstream prose should call it a secondary sound-root image, not substitute collapse for the verse's syntax.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The passive يدعون is adjacent to a groundward act and an inability, allowing the root's cascade branch to color but not replace the call.

activation_trace.role: Successive falling or collapse supplies a cascade image latent under the ordinary summons.
Humble lowering gives the cascade a groundward endpoint that remains specifically prostration.
Negated practical capacity blocks the cascade from resolving into the demanded voluntary act.
Taking degree by degree supplies a contextual sequence that can activate staged rather than instantaneous falling.

changed_reading.before: A call is followed by a simple failed act.
changed_reading.after: As a contained secondary image, the summons initiates a staged groundward cascade that still cannot become willing prostration.

strongest_changes: The repeated earlier obedience choices and 68:43's prior call while sound shift inability from a generic physical deficit toward expired or forfeited pliancy.
The garden sequence makes capacity asymmetric: the same agents are capable when moving to exclude but powerless when disclosure demands submission.
The legal and inscription fields recast prostration as embodied evidence when verbal claims, books, oaths, guarantors, and affiliations fail.
The concealment-to-exposure field lets the severity idiom coexist with disclosure of the support beneath the public person.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sustains several mechanisms at once: idiomatic severity, exposed bodily support, volitional hardening, a material rehearsal of reversed agency, forensic embodiment, and contained vertical or visual reversals. Split mappings for دعو and ط و ع preserve strange but traceable activations without promoting them to translations.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether ساق should foreground the severity idiom, the literal load-bearing limb or stem, or deliberately keep both active.
Whether later inability is caused by earlier refusal, imposed as a new condition, produced by shame, or merely revealed at the event.
How much interpretive weight the non-dominant دعع and سطع mappings and the gaze-dislocation analogy can bear beyond exploratory prose.
